name: cards
description: Agent cards: the agent asks one question as an inline card in the desktop app (the cards_ui tool). Answers come back as ordinary user messages. With the blocks setting on, it also keeps living blocks in the transcript and the right rail (the cards_block tool).
author: Haseeb Khalid

config.description: Offer the agent cards_block: living blocks (a plan, a status, a diff, a note, a metric, a file) that synaps-desk draws in the transcript and the right rail. Off by default; keep it off where only the TUI runs, which shows each call as JSON. Takes effect at synaps daemon reload-extension cards.
